subject: Interim assurance letter and control exception follow-up
messages:
From: security@atlaspayments.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: audits@clearview-auditors.com
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request + exceptions

Hi Ben —

As part of our Q2 vendor review, AtlasPayments needs a copy of Redwood Inference's most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the audit period that includes 2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31. Our external auditor (cc'd) has flagged a couple of open exceptions from last year's report relating to change management and privileged access — we need a brief management response and evidence of remediation or an interim assurance letter covering the audit period before our window closes on 2027-05-20.

Could you confirm: 
- The available SOC 2 Type II report date (if issued) or expected issuance date
- Whether you can provide a signed interim assurance (management response / bridge) covering the exceptions and any remediations implemented to date
- A short list of evidence artifacts (S3 logs, IAM change tickets, remediation tracker) and a target delivery date

Appreciate a reply by EOD 2027-05-03 so we can coordinate with our auditor.

Thanks,
Ava Turner
Security Manager
AtlasPayments
security@atlaspayments.com

Attachment: none
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: security@atlaspayments.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request + exceptions

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the note and the heads-up on timing. Short answers up front: 
- We expect the finalized SOC 2 Type II report to be issued in late June; the auditor's final fieldwork wraps after your audit window.
- We can provide an interim assurance (management response + signed covering letter) that documents the exceptions, remediation progress, and compensating/temporary controls for the audit period you specified.

Next steps I propose: 
1) We will share a draft interim assurance letter and a remediation tracker by 2027-05-06.
2) Grace (security) and Neha (legal) will confirm control closure evidence and the list of artifacts we can upload to the shared Drive link.
3) Final signed interim assurance by 2027-05-12 so you and your auditor have time to review.

Do those milestones work for Atlas? If you prefer a different cadence or need the signed letter sooner, tell us and we'll escalate.

I attached a working remediation tracker for visibility.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments:
- control_remediation_tracker_Atlas.xlsx (sheet: control id, status, remediation owner, target date)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-04T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Atlas request — management response draft and evidence inventory

Ben / Neha / Marissa —

Following Ben's reply to Atlas, here's a concise internal summary and our recommended content for the interim assurance: 

Summary of exceptions (short):
- CHG-102 (change management): missing approvals for a small set of infra change requests during 2026-11. Root cause: emergency hotfix process lacked documented post-facto approvals.
- PWD-57 (privileged access): temporary over-privileged service account active 2026-12 for migration; reverted but audit trail gaps exist.

Remediation status (what we will state in the interim assurance):
- CHG-102: retroactive approvals logged; new approval workflow enforced as of 2027-01-10; automation to require approvals in CI/CD is planned (ETA 2027-06-15). Evidence: change tickets #CHG-201..CHG-206, approval screenshots, JIRA link.
- PWD-57: privileged account removed 2027-01-05; rotation and RBAC adjustments completed; evidence: IAM audit logs, rotation ticket #SEC-482.

Temporary controls to cite: 
- Increased weekly privileged access reviews (documented)
- Additional monitoring and alerting for anomalous service account usage

Planned attachments for Atlas/auditor: 
- control_remediation_tracker_Atlas.xlsx (attached)
- IAM rotation logs (redacted) — will upload to drive
- Change ticket excerpts (PDF exports)
- Draft interim assurance letter (attached PDF)

Neha, please see the draft language I pasted below and advise on legal phrasing. Marissa, please confirm operational artifacts and any additional evidence owners we should loop in.

--- quoted draft language ---
Redwood Inference management confirms that the exceptions identified in the prior report were addressed as described below. While certain automation changes remain in progress, compensating controls have been implemented and monitoring increased. The attached remediation tracker identifies specific artifacts that demonstrate closure or progress for each control.
--- end quote ---

Grace O'Connor
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft_interim_assurance_letter_v0.3.pdf
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: security@atlaspayments.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-06T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Interim assurance letter and evidence upload plan (AtlasPayments)

Hi Ava —

Attached is Redwood Inference's draft interim assurance letter covering the audit period 2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31. The letter includes management's response to the previously identified exceptions, a summary of remediations completed, and a list of evidence artifacts we will make available.

Key points: 
- Management Response: we acknowledge the exceptions and have implemented both permanent and compensating controls as documented in the remediation tracker.
- Evidence delivery: we will place redacted artifacts in the shared Drive folder (link below) by 2027-05-12: change ticket exports, IAM rotation logs, IAM policy snapshots, and the remediation tracker.
- Signature: Please treat the attached PDF as the draft for review; we expect legal sign-off and countersignature by 2027-05-12 pending any material edits.

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_AtlasEvidence

If Clearview needs additional specifics (hashes, full log extracts under NDA, or auditor-only artifacts), let us know and we can coordinate secure transfer.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
General Counsel
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments:

- control_remediation_tracker_Atlas.xlsx

Subject: Re: Interim assurance letter and evidence upload plan (AtlasPayments)

Ben/Neha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft letter. Clearview reviewed the materials and the proposed timetable looks workable. A couple of quick items: 
- Please confirm final signed interim assurance can be delivered by 2027-05-12.
- We will need the listed artifacts in the Drive by 2027-05-12; Clearview may request a short secure log extract under NDA for one item (they will email details).
- If you anticipate any edits to the signed wording that change the scope of the assurance, flag them to me immediately.

Assuming sign-off, this should resolve our audit window — thank you for coordinating.

Best,
Ava Turner

AtlasPayments
